propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 800 lines due to co-located file loading, JSON encoding, rotation ordering, and persistence logic, risking silent data loss during refactoring
BindingRepository must preserve all existing load/save byte contracts, exception semantics, and recovery guarantees while moving persistence behind a facade
GET rotation must complete before live replacement, with failed intermediate states recoverable without format migration or eager rewrites
Legacy records with unknown fields must round-trip byte-equal through direct repository and public facade without triggering eager rewrites
Fault injection (tempfile, rotation replace, retired replace, live replace, alert write failures) must preserve documented raise/swallow/alert behavior matching pre-extraction semantics
Tickets publication remains an external five-file allowlisted seam in reconcile_helpers.py with no broad staging and no commit on unchanged state
